placements.why: Establishes the organization's strategic stratum for system resilience, recovery procedures, and operational readiness drills.
placements.title: Reliability and recovery mechanisms require continuous operational verification
placements.frame: How does the organization verify and maintain its recovery capabilities, fault tolerance, and operational resilience?

placements.title: Unrehearsed rollbacks do not exist as operational capabilities
placements.frame: Does the expression enforce mandatory operational rehearsals as the prerequisite for genuine recovery readiness?
placements.why: Quinton mandates a monthly cadence for Atlas rollback drills on the principle that unpracticed rollback mechanisms cannot be assumed to function.
